title: Ashen + InmisAddon Support
description: A small, 16x pack adding compatibility between Ashen 16x and InmisAddon
body: ![About](https://i.imgur.com/nMG1TNv.png) Want to play Ashen with [InmisAddon](https://modrinth.com/mod/inmisaddon)? Tired of how bright Inmis' default backpacks look when paired with Ashen? Then this Add-On is for you! Place this pack _above_ Ashen in your load order. ___ This pack is designed and intended for use with [Ashen 16x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ashen) & [Ashen + Inmis Support](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ashen-inmis-support) and [Inmis](https://modrinth.com/mod/inmis) & [InmisAddon](https://modrinth.com/mod/inmisaddon).
